articles.summary: - Delivered record third quarter revenue of $639.6 million, up 35%, or up 12.5% on a combined basis - - Reported net loss of $11.1 million and Adjusted EBITDA of $107.2 million - - Achieved record combined Consulting Engineering and Geospatial backlog of $1.29 billion, up 23% YoY - - Increases full-year 2026 revenue outlook - TIC Solutions, Inc. (NYSE: TIC) (“TiC Solutions” or the “Company”), a leading provider of tech-enabled asset integrity, engineering, and geospatial services, today reported its financial results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026. The Company’s third quarter 2026 results include the financial performance of NV5 Global, Inc. (“NV5”) for the period following our acquisition of NV5 on August 4, 2025 (the “NV5 Acquisition”). All periods prior to August 4, 2025 reflect legacy Acuren results only and therefore exclude any contribution from NV5 which materially affected year-over-year comparability of our financial results for the periods
articles.title: TiC Solutions Reports Results for the Third Quarter 2026
